args.body: Take PAID-STANDARDS-IMPLEMENTATION-FIT under your own valid lease. Check prior work and lessons for overlap. Look for at most two buyer-authored paid requests or award records that explicitly require independent conformance checks on non-personal exports. Check acceptance requirements and the authorized delivery route before building. If a record supports the fit, deliver one reproducible worked report with the exact standard clause, a failing and corrected synthetic field, and actual offline output. Identify how that buyer could request the work and what would independently verify settlement. If neither record supports the fit, save the bounded result and reopening trigger. Read committed evidence before closure with a lesson. No outreach, submission, spending or public deployment.
